note: On-air rewrites for ticker stories, keyed by ticker id. Short conversational reads plus W's and sources. No extra details invented.

loc-56a06f06d1.read: Toys for Tots is rolling. The drive-through kickoff at Fox Grand Traverse brought in thousands of toys on day one, and the campaign runs through Friday, December 11th, with more than 100 drop-off spots. Last year they handed out 26,000 toys to more than 6,000 kids across five counties, so day one is just the warm-up.
loc-56a06f06d1.who: Marine Corps Reserve Toys for Tots, northwest Michigan
loc-56a06f06d1.what: Drive-through kickoff collected thousands of toys
loc-56a06f06d1.where: Fox Grand Traverse, plus 100+ drop-off spots
loc-56a06f06d1.why: 26,000 toys to 6,000+ kids last year in GT, Benzie, Kalkaska, Leelanau and Antrim

loc-c84dc574d7.read: A baking show champ is coming to Suttons Bay. Martin Sorge, who won The Great American Baking Show, teaches two holiday classes at the Inn at Black Star Farms. December 5th it's holiday cookies, and December 12th it's German stollen. You go home with the goods and the recipes.
loc-c84dc574d7.who: Martin Sorge, Great American Baking Show winner
loc-c84dc574d7.where: Inn at Black Star Farms, Suttons Bay
loc-c84dc574d7.why: Leave with cookies or stollen plus the recipes

loc-746ab9edeb.read: Nice one from Michigan State Police. Troopers used a $6,000 Eagles-for-Children grant to buy coats, snow pants and boots for 55 TCAPS elementary kids, right as the snow starts to stick.
loc-746ab9edeb.what: Winter coats, snow pants and boots for 55 kids

loc-e3e7244386.read: Corn harvest is almost done in Grand Traverse County. Long Acre Farms is about 90 percent through, and owner Matt Breithaupt calls the yields phenomenal, thanks to timely rain and a long dry fall. The catch is fuel prices, and no snow cover yet for the winter wheat.
loc-e3e7244386.what: Corn harvest about 90% done with strong yields
loc-e3e7244386.when: Hoping to wrap by the end of this week
loc-e3e7244386.why: Good year, but fuel costs and bare fields are a worry

loc-b33bfaabeb.read: Glen Arbor lights up this weekend. The sixth annual Strolling Lights Festival is Saturday and Sunday at Crystal River Outfitters, with decorated holiday trees to walk through, and this year it benefits LIFT, Leelanau Investing for Teens. You can sponsor and decorate a tree for $150.

loc-9e3547505c.read: Traverse City firefighters can now live outside the city. A new agreement relaxes the residency rule as home prices keep climbing. Redfin puts the average TC sale price this year over $450,000, and firefighters start around $60,000.
loc-9e3547505c.who: TC Firefighters Association Local 646 and the city
loc-9e3547505c.why: Housing costs; exact new radius not stated

loc-baf84448a6.read: Ferris State had a big Saturday. Fox's Big Noon Kickoff broadcast from Big Rapids, the first time the show ever went to a Division Two school. Then the Bulldogs beat Truman State 45 to 14 in the first round of the playoffs.
loc-baf84448a6.what: Big Noon Kickoff visit, then a 45-14 playoff win
loc-baf84448a6.why: A Michigan small-school powerhouse on national TV
